payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the mug been moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely having a mug appear there?
node.criteria: Complete if the edited image shows the requested mug to the right of the headphones and its source position is no longer occupied by that mug, with no clear residual or duplicate indicating the move was not completed. Partial if a mug appears to the right of the headphones but the source position remains occupied by the mug or a clear remnant/duplicate indicates incomplete relocation, or if there is other clear progress toward the requested move without completion. Absent if there is no visible progress toward moving the mug to the right of the headphones. Unknown if the source and edited images do not provide sufficient evidence to assess progress or completion. Do not infer object identity, attributes, or source position beyond what is visually supported.
node.binding: The mug and headphones in the source and edited images; compare their visible positions and the source location for evidence of relocation, duplication, or residual artifacts.

outcome.description: Move the mug to the right of the headphones.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image shows a mug to the right of the headphones, but a mug-shaped blue remnant remains at the source mug's left-side position, indicating incomplete relocation.","confidence":0.96}
